# SiftText

> Understanding evolves from evidence.

SiftText preserves the reasoning behind decisions in a tree of related questions so people and AI agents can revisit the evidence across sessions.

The tree lives in Markdown files with Git history, allowing agents to use it across models and apps. When new evidence overturns a decision, the history preserves the earlier reasoning for review.

## Plans

- Core is free for agents with file and terminal access.
- Plus costs $20 USD/month for MCP access to synced cloud trees.
- Pro costs $50 USD/month and includes Plus, with these tools on local or cloud MCP:
  - Cloud browser environment for agents.
  - Writing checks for AI-sounding prose.
  - Automatic tree organization checks.

## Product links

- [Website](https://sifttext.com/) for examples and current plans.
- [Platform](https://app.sifttext.com/) to sign in or manage a subscription.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/gojack10/sifttext-core) to inspect Core.
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gojack10/sifttext-core/main/README.md) for a product overview and development guidance.

## Installation

The preferred path is the official installer:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://sifttext.com/install | sh
```

With the user's permission, the installer installs SiftText and gives the user and agent their next steps.

- For local Core builds, see [INSTALL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gojack10/sifttext-core/main/INSTALL.md).

## Release evidence

- [Latest release](https://github.com/gojack10/sifttext-core/releases/latest) to check for a newer version.

Use SHA256SUMS to verify agreement with published release bytes and separate build-provenance evidence to identify which build produced a package.

## Privacy and contributions

- [Session-retention guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gojack10/sifttext-core/main/integrations/pi/README.md) for private retention, which is off by default. Enable retention or backup only at the user's request.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gojack10/sifttext-core/main/AGENTS.md) for authorized development and repair.
- [PolyForm Perimeter license](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gojack10/sifttext-core/main/LICENSE) permits source access while restricting competing products.
